.gstudio/artifacts/singleton/scripts/cre.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to scaffold the singleton, where <id> is the singleton's identifier (any case, will be converted to camelCase).

.gstudio/artifacts/singleton/scripts/lis.instruction: Run `{{script}} [search term]`, optionally passing a search term to filter singletons whose file contents include it.

.gstudio/artifacts/singleton/scripts/upd.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> <change-request> to verify the singleton for <id> exists before applying the change request.

.gstudio/artifacts/singleton/scripts/del.instruction: Run `{{script}} <id>` where `<id>` is the singleton's id.
Run {{script}} <id> to print every `file path:line number` reference to the singleton identified by `<id>` found in the codebase.

.gstudio/artifacts/singleton/scripts/eva.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> where <id> is the singleton's identifier, to evaluate the corresponding src/singletons/{name}.singleton.ts file against the singleton rules.

create.text: Scaffolds a new singleton file at src/singletons/{name}.singleton.ts given an id and optional initial instance content, failing if the file already exists.

list.text: Lists singleton artifacts under src/singletons matching an optional search term, printing each as id: file path.

update.text: Modifies an existing singleton file at src/singletons/{name}.singleton.ts to satisfy a given change request, erroring if the singleton does not exist.

delete.text: Removes a singleton file by id, then finds and removes all dangling references to it in the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks a singleton's file location, naming, single top-level definition, and required shape against the rules, given a singleton id, and reports pass or itemized errors.
